title: Hierarchical Agentic Incident Response with Digital-Twin-Validated Attack Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.15016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Network incident response remains slow and labor-intensive as the defender must infer multi-stage attacks from partial observations and translate recovery decisions into reliable system commands. Decision-theoretic planners provide principled optimization but typically rely on abstract states and predefined actions, while large language model (LLM) agents can reason over operational context but may hallucinate attacks and responses. Toward automating response planning, we present a hierarchical agentic response framework that integrates LLM-based attack inference, rollout planning, and digital-twin validation. A fine-tuned LLM infers the attack progression and affected hosts from security alerts and system measurements. An emulated network digital twin replays the inferred attack and returns discrepancies between predicted and observed effects to calibrate the inference. A separately fine-tuned planning agent uses the rollout planning

translated_title: 基于数字孪生验证攻击推断的分层代理式事件响应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15016v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：网络事件响应仍然缓慢且劳动密集，因为防御者必须从部分观测中推断多阶段攻击，并将恢复决策转化为可靠的系统命令。决策理论规划器提供了原则性的优化，但通常依赖于抽象状态和预定义动作，而大型语言模型（LLM）代理能够推理操作上下文，但可能产生幻觉性的攻击和响应。为迈向自动化响应规划，我们提出了一种分层代理式响应框架，该框架整合了基于LLM的攻击推断、展开规划和数字孪生验证。一个微调的LLM从安全警报和系统测量中推断攻击进展和受影响主机。一个模拟网络数字孪生重放推断的攻击，并返回预测与观测效果之间的差异以校准推断。一个单独微调的规划代理使用展开规划进行决策。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分层代理式事件响应框架，通过数字孪生验证攻击推断，将LLM推理与展开规划相结合，以提高网络攻击响应的自动化程度和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical agentic incident response framework that integrates LLM-based attack inference with digital-twin validation and rollout planning to enhance automation and reliability of network attack responses.
